To understand how complex systems are and how interconnected things are, consider this: in 2024, half of the Nobel Prize in Physics went to a biologist (experimental and cognitive psychology), Geoffrey Hinton—for fundamental discoveries and inventions in information technology and algorithms that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks. 🤖🧠🔬

A biologist. In Physics. For advancing artificial intelligence. A miracle. ✨
